description: Defines a template class 'RecorderType' for recording and managing time-stamped measurement data with delta compression, including nested classes for reading and writing data to files, with detailed serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: ValueRecorder::RecorderType
classes.description: Template class for recording time-stamped values with delta compression, supporting reading and writing to files.

classes.name: ValueRecorder::RecorderType::BaseRecorder
classes.description: Base class managing storage buffer, start/end metadata, and serialization/deserialization of measurement data.

classes.name: ValueRecorder::RecorderType::Writer
classes.description: Derived class for recording data points and saving them to files with thread safety.

classes.name: ValueRecorder::RecorderType::Reader
classes.description: Derived class for reading recorded data points from files, supporting navigation through data.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a measurement with timestamp and value, updating delta compression.

methods.name: StepForward
methods.description: Advances the current position to the next measurement.

methods.name: StepBack
methods.description: Moves the current position to the previous measurement.

methods.name: SnapShot
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current data state.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads measurement data from a file.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves measurement data to a file.

methods.name: ClearData
methods.description: Resets the data storage to initial state.
